segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמּוֹכֵר אֶת הַחֲמוֹר – מָכַר אֶת הַסְּיָח. מָכַר אֶת הַפָּרָה – לֹא מָכַר אֶת בְּנָהּ. מָכַר אַשְׁפָּה – מָכַר זִבְלָהּ. מָכַר בּוֹר – מָכַר מֵימֶיהָ. מָכַר כַּוֶּורֶת – מָכַר דְּבוֹרִים. מָכַר שׁוֹבָךְ – מָכַר יוֹנִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who sells» a female «donkey has sold» its «foal» along with it. But one who «sold a cow has not sold its young.» One who «sold a dunghill has sold its manure.» One who «sold a cistern has sold its water.» One who «sold a beehive has sold the bees» in it, and likewise one who «sold a dovecote has sold» the «doves.»

moves.summary: lists what the sale of animals and containers includes

positions.claim: a donkey's sale includes its foal but a cow's does not include its calf; dunghill, cistern, beehive and dovecote include their contents
